---
title: "Assignments"
---

Each participant produces **two individual products** over the course (there are no groups): a **research proposal** on their own question (each part modelled live in Sessions 1–7 and written as homework, submitted in Session 8, where about 5 volunteers present) and a **draft manuscript** on one of the five FLUID-ICU questions, Q1 to Q5 (we give you the results pack, you write the paper; written after Sessions 7–8, peer reviewed by a classmate after the course). The marks are formative: they help you improve.

| | What it is | Download |
|:----------------|:----------------------------------------|:--------------|
| **[Proposal brief](proposal-brief.qmd)** | What to produce for the proposal, part by part, with deadlines | [Word](files/assignments/Proposal_Brief.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Proposal_Brief.pdf) |
| **[Presentation guide](presentation-guide.qmd)** | The six slides (everyone), and timekeeping and feedback for the volunteer presentations in Session 8 | [Word](files/assignments/Presentation_Guide.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Presentation_Guide.pdf) |
| **[Proposal rubric](proposal-rubric.qmd)** | How the written proposal (everyone) and the presentation (presenters) are scored (100 points) | [Word](files/assignments/Proposal_Rubric.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Proposal_Rubric.pdf) |
| **[Manuscript brief](manuscript-brief.qmd)** | The FLUID-ICU manuscript: the five questions, what to write and when, rules | [Word](files/assignments/Manuscript_Brief.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Manuscript_Brief.pdf) |
| **[Manuscript rubric](manuscript-rubric.qmd)** | How the manuscript and the peer review are scored (100 points) | [Word](files/assignments/Manuscript_Rubric.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Manuscript_Rubric.pdf) |
| **[Peer-review instructions](peer-review.qmd)** | The individual peer review after Session 8: how to review one classmate's draft and how to respond | [Word](files/assignments/Peer_Review_Instructions.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Peer_Review_Instructions.pdf) |

## Timeline

- **Proposal:** Part 1 after Sessions 1–2, Part 2 after Sessions 3–4, Part 3 after Sessions 5–6, Part 4 after Session 7; submitted by everyone in Session 8 (about 5 volunteers present).
- **Manuscript:** the five questions and Table 1 in Session 5, results interpreted and your question (Q1 to Q5) chosen by the end of Session 6, Methods and Results after Session 7, complete draft after Session 8, then one peer review (within 1 week) and the response letter (within 2 weeks).

The Word templates are on the [Templates](templates.qmd) page.
